snippet.title: Guild Wars Reforged Launch Trailer | PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2025
snippet.description:
Guild Wars Reforged is a major update to ArenaNet's long-running MMORPG. Retrace the footsteps as a returning hero or dive into the unknown as a new adventurer! Join a community as enduring as the Mists themselves—full of veteran heroes eager to guide fresh recruits through missions, dungeons, and hard-mode challenges. Around every turn, thereʼs a new story to uncover, a new title to earn, and a new friend to share the road.

Experience the complete saga—from the fall of Ascalon to the desperate stand against Nightfall.

OUT NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/29720/Guild_Wars_Reforged?snr=1_614_615_pcgamingshowmostwanted2025_100703

https://www.pcgamer.com
